pages.text:
Board of Directors Meeting
                            In-person and Virtual Attendance Options
                  Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 3:00 p.m.
                       Tahoe Blue Event Center, Turquoise Room
                                      75 US-50, Stateline, Nevada

                                      Public Attendance Options:
1. Attend the meeting in person at the address indicated above.
2. To view this meeting on Zoom, visit
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86972874483?pwd=5QDLwdkaUDuDboA0nBRekT5ZLb8KHA.1
or visit
http://zoom.us/join and enter the Webinar ID: 869 7287 4483 Need Password ID: 045349
3. To listen to this Zoom meeting, dial 1-669-900-6833 and enter the Webinar ID when prompted.

                                                  AGENDA
    1. Call to Order
    2. Silent Roll Call
    3. Introduction of Guests and Staff (sign-in)
    4. Public Comment on Non-Agenda items - Limit three (3) minutes per person. No action may
       be taken.

    5. Approval of Agenda
    6. Possible Action: Election of Officers – Carol Chaplin
           a. LTVA Board Chair
           b. LTVA Board Treasurer
    7. Approval of Minutes: October 8, 2026
    8. Possible Action: July 2026 Financial Statements – Katharine Nastasia
    9. Possible Action: August 2026 Financial Statements – Katharine Nastasia
    10. Events Update – Stuart Maas
           a. Possible Action: Event Funding Recommendation $75,000 - PRO Skijor 2027
              Championship Finals – Cierra Ritchie of Caesars Entertainment; Greg Lipstone &
              Brian Gardner of PRO Skijor

                                         VisitLakeTahoe.com
                          PO Box 5878 | 75 US-50 | Stateline, NV 89449 | (775) 588-5900

b. Possible Action: Support for Battle of the Sports – International Endurance
           Competition & Television Production - Clive Grinaker of Battle of the Sports
           Events; Todd Jackson, of Big Blue Adventures

 11. Possible Action: January – June 2027 Media Plan – Noble Studios
 12. Possible Action: Winter Creative – Noble Studios
 13. Possible Action: Data and KPIs Working Group – Carol Chaplin
 14. Possible Action: Lodging Industry Survey – Carol Chaplin
        a. All Lodging Results
        b. Small/Mid-Size Lodging Properties Results
 15. Updates by Staff
 16. Recommendations for Future Agenda Items
 17. Updates by Board Members

    This is an opportunity for Board members to present updates on meetings they have
    attended, legislative matters, or other items that are relevant to the mission of the Lake
    Tahoe Visitors Authority. There will be no action taken on these items other than to
    possibly request that items be placed on future agendas or to direct staff to further
    investigate the matter.

 18. Public Comment - Limit three (3) minutes per person. No action may be taken.
 19. Next Meeting: Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 3:00 p.m., Turquoise Room
 20. Adjournment


NOTE: We are pleased to make accommodations for members of the public who are differently
abled. Please notify in writing at PO Box 5878, Stateline, NV 89449 or call (775) 589-2052 prior to
the meeting. In accordance with Nevada Revised Statute Chapter 241, this agenda closes three
days prior to the meeting day and was posted on www.LTVA.org and the NV State posting website
at www.notice.nv.gov. Notice of this meeting was emailed and/or faxed for posting to the following
locations: Douglas County Library – Minden Branch, 1625 Library Lane, Minden, NV; City of South
Lake Tahoe, CA City Offices, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA; El Dorado County Library
– South Lake Tahoe Branch, 1000 Rufus Allen Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA; Kahle Community Center,
236 Kingsbury Grade Rd, Stateline, NV.




                                   VisitLakeTahoe.com
                    PO Box 5878 | 75 US-50 | Stateline, NV 89449 | (775) 588-5900
